scenario.title: Global context, project context and deeper agent knowledge
situations: Agent starts outside any Yoke project
Agent starts in a configured project
Work needs a new skill, schema or project fact
A main agent delegates or resumes after compaction
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Does every action-bearing role get the right context with no source-checkout assumptions?
What survives compaction or handoff, and what must be read again?
Are instruction, schema, live-state and evidence authorities clearly separated?
Trace SESSION.md and other harness-native continuity files by actual loading/ownership, without assuming a universal file exists.
Do not treat UI preferences as a general agent-memory store. JOURNEYS reminder suppression remains an open design question.

lessons.title: Small global orientation; project rules take over locally
lessons.need: Outside a project, learn how to find/select/add one and coordinate. Inside it, load standing rules and project orientation without duplicate hooks or unrelated-repository policing.
lessons.surface: Native rule files + global/project hooks + orientation
lessons.gap: P1–P4 are planned. Current projectless registration/orientation must not be drawn as globally shipped. The verified Claude session-rule file is one native surface; loading differs by harness.
surface_notes: Global orientation + yoke-global: FIRST-USER P1–P4: outside-project sessions receive light orientation and a route to select/add/open projects. Not a shipped global context claim.

Project orientation payload: Project hook/session identity → short orientation delivered to the agent; names identity, checkout, advisories and deeper pointers. Its producer code is separate audit evidence.

lessons.title: Fetch the current operation’s depth
lessons.when: Before the relevant authorized action or during recovery
lessons.need: Use the skill router, current phase and conditional supplements. Read operation rules, command help and the relevant packet. Live reads establish state; prose is a guide to those reads.
lessons.surface: Skill → phase → operation rules / CLI help / role-topic packet
lessons.gap: JOURNEYS depth wording should cover already-authorized work and recovery. It should not require a redundant new permission request before reading needed instructions.
surface_notes: Role/topic packet: main_agent + relevant topic: Fetched through packets render; role and topic choose schema/recipe depth. This is not a saved project README or proof of current domain state.

lessons.title: Load this project’s knowledge and pass it to workers
lessons.when: Implementation, planning, delegation and resumed work
lessons.need: Resolve registered context_routing; read always plus relevant topics in the right checkout. Dispatch carries item, lane, policies, QA and project context, then the role’s specific instructions.
lessons.surface: Registered project context → project documents → role adapter / task prompt
lessons.gap: Accepted Conduct repair replaces its source-only loader. Conditional role references need harness-correct rendering. Empty configuration and failed reads must remain distinct.
surface_notes: Registered context_routing → project-owned documents: Registered entries map always and topic keys to payload.docs paths. Resolve the registered checkout/claimed lane, then read the actual files; configuration absence differs from read failure.

lessons.title: Reach help before choosing a project
lessons.when: Projectless question, installation recovery or unfamiliar operation
lessons.need: CLI help and public product docs remain reachable before a project is selected. Installed .yoke/docs belongs to the project layer and cannot be assumed in an unrelated folder.
lessons.surface: Root/operation help → public docs; planned global guide points to the same route
lessons.gap: Make this explicit in yoke-global and global orientation. A bare README.md in the current directory is not Yoke product help.
surface_notes: https://upyoke.com/docs: Accessible without a local project document tree; online access is distinct from offline CLI help.

lessons.title: Deliver the role and conditional depth to the worker
lessons.when: Delegating an authorized task or continuing its current phase
lessons.need: Canonical role → generated harness adapter → relevant conditional references, plus a dispatch prompt carrying item, lane, policies, project docs and QA. The Engineer paths are a concrete example of the role family.
lessons.surface: Role renderer + harness-native adapter + task-specific dispatch context
lessons.gap: Shared conditional references currently use Claude rendering; the accepted harness-correct access repair still needs proof. This example does not certify every role/harness combination.
surface_notes: Task-specific dispatch prompt: Carries the actual item/artifacts, registered lane, resolved policies, relevant project/QA facts and role assignment. It is separate from native startup loading.

lessons.title: Write to the user in one or two short sentences
lessons.need: Keep each message to one or two short, literal sentences unless the user asks for more. Describe every number or ID, explain an unfamiliar name once, and ask one decision at a time with a recommendation. Required instructions and recipes stay complete.
lessons.gap: Sessions outside any Yoke project do not receive the rule yet; see gap user-writing-outside-projects.
